name: This_4
short_caption: The robot extends its right arm forward with an open hand, then closes it into a gentle pointing or holding posture before returning to rest.
movement_description: Starting from a neutral posture, the robot raises its right arm forward to about chest height with an open palm. It then transitions its right hand into a loose pointing gesture with fingers curled and the index finger slightly extended. After a brief pause to hold this pose, the arm lowers smoothly back down to its side, returning to the neutral resting position.
